perspectiveDescription: high three-quarter isometric view from above, the camera looking down on the yard at roughly 30 to 35 degrees, ground plane receding to the upper right

stevie.description: Stevie, a stocky, rounded adult raccoon on short legs, grey-brown with a darker streaked back and a warm tan underside, dark legs and paws, a dark eye mask, cream muzzle and brows, rounded pale-rimmed ears and a full ringed tail with a dark tip

jimothy.description: Jimothy, a short-spined, round, hunched and chubby raccoon with a very fluffy coat and a big fluffy banded tail

gracie.description: Gracie, an adult raccoon whose lower body (belly, flanks and hindquarters, down over her legs) has lighter, greyer, noticeably longer and shaggier fur than her back; a full dark eye mask with pale brows and a pale muzzle, rounded pale-rimmed ears and a ringed tail

notes: realism: high-quality illustrated realism, never photographic and never cartoon-flat; characters are naturalistic and the environment a touch painterly (see looks)
lighting: warm amber lantern and window light against cool blue-grey dusk and rain; soft rim light separating fur from the background
colour: full colour, soft alpha; never pixel art
no text, logos or watermarks in the art
rendering: naturalistic; very high-quality naturalistic rendering like Stevie's approved turnaround; soft, believable fur and anatomy; never photographic and never painterly
texture: fine, soft, naturalistic fur with fur strands at every silhouette edge; no visible brushwork
detail: high on faces, masks and banded tails; medium on fur bodies
rendering: painterly; painterly and deliberately less photorealistic than the cast, so the backyard never competes with the characters; believable materials
texture: soft visible brushwork; a wet sheen on stone and wood
detail: medium on the house, porch, path and props; lower on background foliage
